title: Dyadic parameter identity
statement: Let $t,\ell,n\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $t\leq\ell$ and $n=2^{\ell-t}$. Then, as an identity in $\mathbb{R}$, $\frac{n-1}{2^\ell}=\left(\frac12\right)^t-\left(\frac12\right)^\ell$.
